choice: Do not ship an ExtensionKit extension; the panel is a Dock web page. The probe's Xcode project was deleted and the extension unregistered.
consequences: Revisit if cmux lets ExtensionKit extensions live in the right sidebar.
context: cmux 0.65 ships CmuxExtensionKit, a public SDK for compiled sidebar extensions: a macOS ExtensionKit appex with a SwiftUI view, a typed workspace snapshot and workspace/surface/openURL actions. A probe was built, signed with an Apple Development team, registered with pluginkit and enabled in cmux; it received the selected workspace's branch, project path and pull request URLs and reached the Linear API.
rejected: The ExtensionKit route: (a) cmux hosts extensions only as a left-sidebar provider that replaces the workspace list; no right-sidebar mode exists for them (checked cmux v0.65.0 and main). (b) The extension process lives only while its view is mounted, so nothing runs in the background. (c) App Sandbox: no access to the repository's git remote or files without user-granted bookmarks, so the repo could only be guessed from the folder name. (d) Needs Xcode, an Apple Development certificate, and the GPL-3.0 SDK checked out from the cmux monorepo (not a SwiftPM package); the API key could only be baked into the bundle's Info.plist from a build-time .env.
title: Rejected: building the sidebar as a CmuxExtensionKit (ExtensionKit) app extension
